end.summary:
Practised copying shapes on dot and square grids by counting side lengths.
Counted grid units and placed dots to copy rectangles, including 5 by 2.
Recognised that turning or moving a shape keeps its size and shape in several examples.
Mixed up a turned square with a different shape when it looked like a diamond; this was not corrected after the last occurrence.
end.parentNote: Myra practised counting units along grid sides and placing dots to copy rectangles. They explained that a turned rectangle can remain the same shape and size, but later mixed up a turned square with a new shape because it looked like a diamond; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to turn a paper square in different directions and name it each time while checking that its four equal sides remain unchanged.
